name: My Private GitHub Repos

steps.expression: return (input.scope.fetch_repos.data || []).filter((r) => r.owner && r.owner.login === 'MikeBild').map((r) => ({ name: r.name, full_name: r.full_name, private: r.private, html_url: r.html_url, description: r.description, updated_at: r.updated_at }));

description: List private GitHub repos owned by MikeBild
